title: ACI Worldwide and Circle collaborate on LatAm payments
summary: ACI Worldwide (NASDAQ: ACIW), an original innovator in global payments technology, and Circle Internet Group (NYSE: CRCL), one of the world's leading internet financial platform companies and the issuer of USDC1 through its regulated entities, today announced a collaboration to show how stablecoin settlement can be integrated into existing banking and payment infrastructure.

title: OKX reaches $36bn in onchain assets
summary: OKX, a leading global cryptocurrency exchange and onchain technology company, today marked four years of its Proof of Reserves (PoR) program, with $36.36 billion in on-chain assets across 22 major cryptocurrencies.

title: Canton Foundation backs RedStone to build pricing standard
summary: RedStone, the data layer for institutional DeFi, today announced that the Canton Foundation has unanimously approved funding through the Canton Development Fund to develop the Canton Access and Privacy Standard (CAPS), an open-source framework for institutional market-data infrastructure on Canton. CAPS is designed to let institutions price transactions on Canton without revealing their underlying positions or agreed settlement values to data providers.

title: Liquidity Services deploys Flywire tech for domestic and cross-border B2B payments
summary: Flywire Corporation (Nasdaq: FLYW), a global payments enablement and software company, today announced that Liquidity Services Inc. (Nasdaq: LQDT) has implemented Flywire to run both domestic and cross-border B2B payments for the global e-commerce marketplace, with over $15 billion in total completed transactions over the course of Liquidity Services International's 25 year history.

title: SettleMint integrates digital asset lifecycle platform with IBM Digital Asset Haven
